docs.text: Laboratory work 3. Django REST Framework clinic API Student: Fedorova Maria Group: K3339 Variant: 10 — Medical clinic Goal Build a REST API with Django, Django REST Framework, Djoser token auth and PostgreSQL. Cover the clinic domain, analytical queries from the assignment, MkDocs documentation and a React client (same folder architecture as Lab 2). Variant summary The system stores doctors, work schedules, cabinets, price-list services, patients (medical cards) and paid appointments. After each visit the patient pays for the service separately. Implemented operations: User registration / login via Djoser ( /api/auth/ ) CRUD for doctors, patients, cabinets, services, appointments Mark appointment as paid Analytical endpoints listed in the variant Staff report for doctors in a date range Architecture Layer Stack Backend Django 6 + DRF + Djoser (Token) Database PostgreSQL ( tours_db , schema clinic ) Frontend React (Vite) + axios + SCSS Docs MkDocs Lr3/ ├── backend/ # Django API (clinic app) ├── frontend/ # React client ├── practice/ # Practice 3.1 (cars ORM) + 3.2 (warriors DRF) └── docs/ # MkDocs report Data model Doctor FIO, specialty, education, gender, birth date work_start / work_end, employment contract number and date related schedules ( related_name="schedules" ) DoctorSchedule weekday (0–6), is_working Cabinet number, work hours, responsible doctor, internal phone Service price-list item: name, specialty, price Patient medical card: FIO, birth date, gender, phone, address, passport, card_number Appointment patient, doctor, cabinet, service visited_at, diagnosis, condition, recommendations cost (copied from service), is_paid Auth (Djoser) Method URL Purpose POST /api/auth/users/ register POST /api/auth/token/login/ get token ( auth_token ) GET /api/auth/users/me/ current user GET /api/me/ same profile via clinic app Client stores token and sends Authorization: Token <key> . API endpoints Base prefix: /api/ Method URL Access Purpose GET/POST /doctors/ GET all / POST staff doctors GET/PATCH/DELETE /doctors/<id>/ GET all / write staff doctor detail GET/POST /patients/ auth patients GET/POST /appointments/ auth visits PATCH /appointments/<id>/pay/ auth mark paid GET/POST /services/ , /cabinets/ mixed dictionaries GET /analytics/doctor-patients/?doctor= auth patients of a doctor GET /analytics/ent-patients/ auth ENT patients born after 1987 GET /analytics/doctors-by-weekday/?weekday= auth doctors working that day GET /analytics/appointments-by-date/ auth counts by date GET /analytics/costs/ auth sums by day and doctor GET /analytics/paid-patients/ auth patients who paid GET /analytics/doctors-report/?from=&to= staff income report Frontend pages Same layout style as Lab 2 ( pages/ , components/ , context/AuthContext/ , SCSS): / — doctors catalog (search, filter, pagination) /doctors/:id — doctor card + schedule /patients — list + create medical card /appointments — visits, create, pay /analytics — all analytical queries + staff report /login , /register — Djoser auth Practice 3.1 / 3.2 Folder practice/ : practice_3_1/ — автомобили из практики 2.1: ORM create / filter / aggregate ( orm_queries.py ) practice_3_2/ — воины: DRF serializers, CRUD, related_name / m2m See practice/README.md . Run Backend source /path/to/.venv/bin/activate cd students/k3339/Fedorova_Maria/Lr3/backend pip install -r requirements.txt python manage.py migrate python manage.py seed_clinic python manage.py runserver Demo users after seed: Login Password Role admin admin123 admin (full access) manager manager123 staff doctor doctor123 doctor (ENT Smirnova) patient patient123 patient (Petrova) Roles: Guest / new user — doctors catalog; after register can create own medical card Patient — own appointments + pay Doctor — own patients / appointments, create visits (forced to self) Admin — full CRUD + analytics / reports API: http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/ Frontend cd students/k3339/Fedorova_Maria/Lr3/frontend npm install npm run dev Client: http://127.0.0.1:5173 MkDocs cd students/k3339/Fedorova_Maria/Lr3 mkdocs serve Tests cd backend && python manage.py test clinic cd ../practice/practice_3_1 && python manage.py test cd ../practice_3_2 && python manage.py test PostgreSQL note Tables live in schema clinic inside PostgreSQL database tours_db (user tours_user ) so Lab 2 and Lab 3 stay isolated without a separate superuser database. Settings use search_path=clinic,public .
